def snap_to_slot(time_str: str, slot_minutes: int = 15) -> str:
    """Round a clock time to the nearest booking slot boundary.

    ``time_str`` is a 24-hour ``"HH:MM"`` time. Slot boundaries are the
    multiples of ``slot_minutes`` counted from midnight. The time is rounded
    to the nearest boundary; a time exactly halfway between two boundaries
    rounds to the boundary with an even slot index (round-half-to-even, the
    same rule as Python's :func:`round`), e.g. with 30-minute slots
    ``"08:45"`` -> ``"09:00"`` and ``"09:15"`` -> ``"09:00"``. A result of
    24:00 wraps to ``"00:00"``. The result is formatted as zero-padded
    ``"HH:MM"``.

    ``slot_minutes`` must be a positive integer that divides 1440 evenly,
    otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised. A malformed time also raises
    ``ValueError``.
    """
    minutes = parse_hhmm(time_str)
    if slot_minutes <= 0:
        raise ValueError("slot_minutes must be positive")
    if MINUTES_PER_DAY % slot_minutes:
        raise ValueError(f"slot_minutes must divide {MINUTES_PER_DAY} evenly: {slot_minutes}")
    quotient, remainder = divmod(minutes, slot_minutes)
    half = 2 * remainder
    if half > slot_minutes or (half == slot_minutes and quotient % 2):
        quotient += 1
    snapped = (quotient * slot_minutes) % MINUTES_PER_DAY
    return f"{snapped // 60:02d}:{snapped % 60:02d}"
